description: Conformant PDF/A-2b with embedded fonts (pdfnative 1.7 via generate_basic_pdf v1.6.0). `embedFonts: true` embeds Noto Sans Latin instead of relying on the viewer's base-14 Helvetica, which ISO 19005 §6.2.11.4.1 requires for a valid PDF/A claim; `includeDiagnostics: true` echoes the conformance diagnostics (expected empty here) in the structured result. Add `strict: true` to fail the call instead of producing a non-conformant file. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.

blocks.text: This document claims PDF/A-2b conformance with every font embedded, so veraPDF accepts it.
